summary: The player fights the boss (The Warden's core, shaped like a heart), dodging arcs of pink bullets while alternating between scanning/focusing and firing charged shots and short streams at it.

events.evidence: Large cyan projectile travels up toward the heart-shaped boss at the start of the clip.
The boss flashes white and a hit sound plays as the cyan projectile impacts.
A wide cyan scanning cone projects from the player ship toward the boss; 'Scanning' bar fills at top left.
Player fires a brief stream of small cyan shots upward.
Stream shots hit the boss, causing rapid white flashes and impact sounds.
Wide cyan scanning cone activates again as player moves left.
Player releases a charged cyan projectile while cannon meter resets.
Charged projectile hits the boss, which flashes bright white with a heavy impact sound.
Cyan scanning cone appears again, sweeping toward the boss.
Player fires a charged shot upward from the bottom left.
Shot impacts the left side of the heart boss with a flash.

readability_issues.issue: Pink oval debris/pickups floating down look very similar in color and shape to the pink enemy bullets.
